Keyed Deterministic Reversible PII Pseudonymization (HMAC-SHA256)

Source: R/pii.R
pii_pseudonymize.Rd

Replaces detected PII entities with deterministic HMAC-SHA256 keyed pseudonym tokens (e.g., <<PERSON_NAME_a3f81c920b>>) so the same sensitive value maps consistently across documents while keeping original identifiers isolated in a separate local mapping vault (airgap_pii_vault).

Usage

pii_pseudonymize(
  text,
  key,
  config = pii_config(),
  vault = NULL,
  vault_path = NULL,
  encrypt_vault = TRUE,
  token_length = 10L
)

Arguments

text

Character vector of documents to pseudonymize.

key

Secret key (character string or raw vector, e.g., from pii_vault_key()).

config

An pii_config() configuration object.

vault

Optional existing airgap_pii_vault created with the same key to accumulate mappings across batches.

vault_path

Optional file path where the mapping vault is immediately saved via pii_vault_save().

encrypt_vault

Logical scalar; encrypt saved vault file when vault_path is provided. Defaults to TRUE.

token_length

Integer number of hex characters (8 to 32) from the HMAC-SHA256 digest used in each pseudonym token. Defaults to 10L.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_pseudonymized" with elements:

  • text: pseudonymized character vector

  • vault: separate airgap_pii_vault mapping tokens back to raw values

  • report: aggregate-only airgap_privacy_report (zero raw PII)

  • vault_path: saved vault path or NULL

Examples

key <- pii_vault_key()
docs <- c("Dr. Jane Doe called (555) 234-5678.", "Follow-up with Dr. Jane Doe.")
res <- pii_pseudonymize(docs, key = key)
res$text
#> [1] "<<PERSON_NAME_af1025f774>> called <<PHONE_ecb4dbbdfe>>."
#> [2] "Follow-up with <<PERSON_NAME_af1025f774>>."             
pii_reidentify(res$text, res$vault)
#> [1] "Dr. Jane Doe called (555) 234-5678." "Follow-up with Dr. Jane Doe."
